failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: sw-cost-test.sh 'CONTEXT EFFICIENCY' dashboard tests fail because the cost dashboard prints 'No cost entries in the last 30 days' and exits early, never rendering the context-efficiency section from the seeded loop.context_efficiency events (test seeds only events, no cost entries).
failures.fix: Make the cost dashboard render the CONTEXT EFFICIENCY section even when there are no cost entries (or have the test seed a cost entry/use an events path the dashboard reads) so the avg budget utilization assertions pass.

failures.root_cause: Two suites failed: sw-e2e-integration-test hit a stale pipeline lock/state ('pipeline already in progress') left by the outer pipeline run, and sw-intent-analysis-test failed its schema check for required fields (version, goal, criteria).
failures.fix: Make the e2e integration test run with isolated state/lock dir (or skip when a pipeline is already running), and update the intent analysis schema or the analyze_intent output so they agree on the required fields.

failures.root_cause: sw-intent-analysis-test.sh failed with 1 of 78 tests failing (exit 1 after 38s); sw-e2e-integration-test also timed out at 301s, likely because it needs real Claude/GitHub access
failures.fix: Run scripts/sw-intent-analysis-test.sh directly to identify the failing assertion and fix it; separately skip or mock sw-e2e-integration-test in CI so it can't hit the 300s timeout

failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test timed out after 301s (300s suite limit) because it makes real Claude/GitHub calls that hang or run too slowly in CI, causing the single FAIL among 128 suites
failures.fix: Skip or mock sw-e2e-integration-test in CI (gate on API credentials), or raise its per-suite timeout above 300s

failures.root_cause: sw-cost-test.sh 'context efficiency' dashboard test fails: `shipwright cost show` prints 'No cost entries in the last 30 day(s)' and exits early, so the CONTEXT EFFICIENCY section built from loop.context_efficiency events is never rendered (test seeds only events, no cost entries).
failures.fix: Make sw-cost.sh render the CONTEXT EFFICIENCY section even when there are no cost entries (don't return early), or have the test seed a cost entry alongside the loop.context_efficiency events.

failures.root_cause: The E2E pipeline test suite (sw-pipeline-test.sh) fails 6 tests: plan.md and review.md artifacts are not generated (the mocked claude call isn't producing them), and the intelligence-skip and cleanup tests fail on jq parse errors from non-JSON output and a non-zero pipeline exit.
failures.fix: Fix the mock claude/plan and review stage setup so plan.md and review.md are written to .claude/pipeline-artifacts, and make the intelligence/RL code emit valid JSON (or have the test filter ANSI/non-JSON lines) so jq parsing and pipeline exit 0 succeed.

failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: sw-cost-test.sh 'context efficiency' assertions fail because the cost dashboard reports 'No cost entries in the last 30 days' and exits before rendering the CONTEXT EFFICIENCY section from the seeded loop.context_efficiency events (test events/timestamps are not seen, or the section is skipped when costs.json is empty).
failures.fix: In sw-cost-test.sh, seed at least one cost entry (and events with current timestamps in the events file the script reads) before running the dashboard, or change sw-cost.sh to render the CONTEXT EFFICIENCY section even when there are no cost entries.

failures.root_cause: The self-optimize test 'Memory promotion copies cross-repo patterns' failed (15/16 passed); the promotion step did not copy patterns to the global memory location, likely due to test environment or HOME/repo-hash path differences. The 'repeated error loop' line is just a passing progress test, not the real failure.
failures.fix: Run scripts/sw-self-optimize-test.sh to see the memory promotion assertion, then fix the promotion function or its test setup so the cross-repo patterns file is created in the expected temp HOME path.

failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m✓[0m Unknown measurement fails open as progress
failures.root_cause: The shown log is only passing output (the matched 'Unknown measurement fails open as progress' line is a ✓ passing test from the flatline-detection suite); all visible suites report FAIL: 0, so the real failure is in a suite not shown (truncated) or a non-test exit/timeout of the test stage.
failures.fix: Re-run the full test stage and grep the complete log for '✗' or 'FAIL: [1-9]' (e.g. via sw-test-all.sh) to find the actual failing suite; check sw-loop-test.sh and sw-lib-compat-test.sh flatline cases first.
